designed_voices.name: Elena
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a warm, gentle young adult American female voice with a mid-to-high pitch and soft texture. Deliver at a measured, calm pace with exceptionally clear articulation. Keep the intonation patient and comforting, making complex language concepts easy to follow for learners.

designed_voices.name: Nora
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a confident, polished middle-aged female voice with a crisp General American accent. Maintain a professional yet accessible energy at a steady, rhythmic pace. Stress key vocabulary naturally while keeping speech clean and easy to follow.

designed_voices.name: Grace
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a soothing, supportive young adult female voice with a low-to-mid pitch and soft, airy texture. Keep the delivery calm and encouraging with a slightly slower pace. Place slight emphasis on sentence stress to help ESL students grasp rhythm effortlessly.

designed_voices.name: Oliver
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a mature, crisp middle-aged male voice with a classic British RP accent. Pitch is balanced in the mid-range with an authoritative yet encouraging tone. Maintain a steady, deliberate pace with subtle pauses after key target vocabulary to aid listening comprehension.

designed_voices.name: Julian
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a deep, warm male voice with a smooth, resonant timbre and a General American accent. Deliver content with a calm, confident style at a relaxed pace. Ensure pristine articulation and deliberate timing so learners can hear subtle phonetic details effortlessly.

designed_voices.name: Ethan
designed_voices.instruct: Speak in a friendly, conversational American male voice with a balanced mid-range pitch and a relaxed texture. Sound like an approachable study buddy chatting casually over coffee. Keep your pace steady and your speech completely unhurried and clear.

candidate_voices.name: Audrey
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a warm, refined young adult British RP female voice with a clear, mid-range pitch. Sound friendly, patient, and conversational, perfect for explaining daily scenarios to language learners. Maintain a steady pace with crisp articulation and natural pauses between key phrases.

candidate_voices.name: Caleb
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a lively, upbeat young adult American male voice with a bright, mid-high pitch and energetic tone. Deliver words with clear pronunciation and expressiveness, like an enthusiastic podcast host guiding a student. Keep the tempo dynamic yet easy to follow.

candidate_voices.name: Beatrice
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a gentle, warm senior American female voice with a soft, lower-mid pitch and a cozy texture. Use a slow, reassuring pace that gives English learners time to absorb every sentence. Prioritize smooth, precise articulation with a comforting bedtime storyteller vibe.

candidate_voices.name: Marcus
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a deep, authoritative middle-aged American male voice with a rich timbre and calm demeanor. Maintain a measured, deliberate pace suitable for formal vocabulary lessons and educational narration. Ensure crystal-clear enunciation with subtle emphasis on key terms.

candidate_voices.name: Graham
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a mature, polished British RP male voice with a smooth, lower-mid pitch and crisp tone. Sound educated, confident, and patient, ideal for advanced grammar breakdowns. Deliver sentences with natural rhythm, excellent clarity, and distinct pauses.

candidate_voices.name: Sophia
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a calm, highly empathetic young adult American female voice with a soft, mid-range pitch. Maintain a relaxed pace with gentle inflection, making complex sentences feel approachable. Focus on clean enunciation and learner-friendly breathing pauses.

candidate_voices.name: Hannah
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a confident, clear middle-aged American female voice with a resonant, crisp mid-range pitch. Project a professional news-anchor energy that remains engaging and approachable for international listeners. Use precise articulation with well-spaced, rhythmic phrasing.

candidate_voices.name: Silas
candidate_voices.instruct: Speak in a warm, slightly husky senior American male voice with a deep pitch and reflective tone. Sound like a friendly grandfather sharing memorable life lessons. Deliver speech at an easygoing, deliberate pace with pronounced clarity on every word.
